scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Your base level is too low, come back when you hit level 130.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
您的基础等级太低了，请达到130级后再来。

scripts.text: ^ff0000If you do any monster processing, such as monster taming within the dungeon, it won't count towards your progress. Please take note.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000如果您在地下城内进行魔物处理，例如驯服魔物，将不计入进度。请注意这一点。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Oh, a curious onlooker? I'm Marry Jay, the person in charge of Fridays among the days of the week.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
哦，是一位好奇的旁观者吗？我是玛丽·杰伊，负责一周中星期五事务的人。

scripts.text: When is the opening time?
scripts.translation: 开放时间是什么时候？

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
The dungeon will be open during:
^0000FFFriday 00:00 ~ Friday 23:59^000000
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
地下城将在以下时间开放：
^0000FFFriday 00:00 ~ Friday 23:59^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
I hope to see you when Friday arrives~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
期待星期五到来时与您相见~

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Sorry, but the entry period to the {0} has expired.
Take a rest while waiting for the dungeon to be available again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
很抱歉，{0}的进入时间已过期。
请休息片刻，等待地下城再次开放。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
The cooldown has expired.
You may re-enter the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
紧急冷却已结束。
您可以重新进入记忆地下城。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
You came just in time.
The memorial dungeon is just ready to be opened.
Would you like to enter now?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
您来得正是时候。
记忆地下城即将开放。
您现在要进入吗？

scripts.text: Enter Friday Memorial
scripts.translation: 进入周五副本

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
The Memorial Dungeon has been created.
You may now enter.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
记忆地下城已创建。
您现在可以进入了。

scripts.text: Only party members can enter this Memorial dungeon.
scripts.translation: 只有队伍成员才能进入这个记忆地下城。

scripts.text: There is no Memorial Dungeon registered.
scripts.translation: 没有注册的记忆地下城。

scripts.text:
The Friday Memorial Dungeon does not exist.
Your party leader has not yet created the Memorial dungeon.
scripts.translation:
周五副本不存在。
您的队伍首领尚未创建记忆地下城。

scripts.text: An unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
去吧！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
You have not prepared?
Can't really help it I guess
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
您还没准备好吗？
那我也没办法了。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Before we start setting up the environment here, we'll give you the chance to choose an appropriate difficulty level.
I could make my own choice, but each person handles it differently based on their abilities.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
在开始布置这里的环境之前，我会给您选择合适难度的机会。
虽然我可以替您做决定，但每个人根据自己的能力处理方式不同。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
You can't choose this difficulty, because your base level is below 200.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
由于您的基础等级低于200级，无法选择此难度。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jay]
Your base level is too low to select this, you need to be level {0} or above.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰伊]
您的基础等级太低，无法选择此项，需要达到{0}级或以上。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of objects. Clear your inventory.
scripts.translation: 您拥有的物品种类太多。请清理您的背包。

scripts.text: Can't continue because you have too many heavy objects. Reduce your total weight by clearing your inventory.
scripts.translation: 由于您携带的重型物品过多，无法继续。请清理背包以减轻总重量。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
If you bring me a {0}, I can enchant a wonderful effect on your accessory!
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
如果您给我{0}，我就能为您的饰品附魔出奇妙的效果！

scripts.text: What can you do with the Crafting Stone?
scripts.translation: 你能用制作石做什么？

scripts.text: Accessory Enchantment
scripts.translation: 饰品附魔

scripts.text: Reset Enchant
scripts.translation: 重置附魔

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I trade expensive stones from the dungeon in exchange for my craftsmanship. I'm still a beginner, but my skills are passable.
Please take care of me.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
我用地下城里的昂贵宝石交换我的手艺。我虽然还是个新手，但技术还算过得去。
请多关照。

scripts.text: I've heard this before.
scripts.translation: 我听过这些了。

scripts.text: I'm listening.
scripts.translation: 我在听。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Is that so?
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
是吗？

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
By using the Craft Stone, I can enchant one of your accessories with abilities.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
通过使用制作石，我可以为您的一个饰品附魔能力。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I need 10 x {0} and 100,000 Zeny.
There is no failure in the enchantment process.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
我需要10个{0}和100,000 Zeny。
附魔过程不会失败。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
However ^0000FFif the accessory has a random option, the random option will be removed after enchantment.^000000
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
不过^0000FF如果饰品有随机选项，附魔后随机选项将会被移除。^000000

scripts.text: Anything else?
scripts.translation: 还有其他吗？

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Cards slotted to the accessory will remain after the enchantement.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
镶嵌在饰品上的卡片在附魔后会保留。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
A reset is possible, but I can't say that I'm experienced.
My success rate is:
Royal Ring: 80%
Other Accessory: 20%
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
可以重置，但我不能说我很有经验。
我的成功率是：
皇家戒指：80%
其他饰品：20%

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
^0000FFIf the accessory has a random option, the random option will be removed after initialization.^000000
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
^0000FF如果饰品有随机选项，初始化后随机选项将会被移除。^000000

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Please equip your accessory.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
请装备您的饰品。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I cannot {0} this {1} accessory.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
我无法{0}这个{1}饰品。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} already has maximum enchantment.
I cannot work on this any further.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
{0}已经达到了最大附魔等级。
我无法再进行任何操作了。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Please select an enchantment type~
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
请选择附魔类型~

scripts.text: Physical
scripts.translation: 物理

scripts.text: Magical
scripts.translation: 魔法

scripts.text: Ranged
scripts.translation: 远程

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Are you sure to enhance the {0}?
^0000FFThere is a no chance of failure^000000.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
确定要附魔{0}吗？
^0000FF没有失败的可能性^000000。

scripts.text: Yes, please proceed
scripts.translation: 是的，请继续

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

Please bring me 10 x {0}.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
请给我10个{0}。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I need 100,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
我需要100,000 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} has been enchanted!!
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
{0}已经附魔完成！！

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} already has an enchant.
I cannot work on this any further.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
{0}已经附魔过了。
我无法再进行任何操作了。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
Are you sure you want to enhance the {0}?
^0000FFThere is a no chance of failure^000000.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
确定要附魔{0}吗？
^0000FF没有失败的可能性^000000。

scripts.text: Yes, please proceed
scripts.translation: 是的，请继续

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

The {0} has been enchanted with {1}.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
{0}已经附魔了{1}。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
The {0} is not at its maximum enchantment.
I cannot reset this accessory.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
{0}尚未达到最大附魔等级。
我无法重置这个饰品。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
All enchanted effects will be removed from the {0}?
^FF0000There is a {1}% chance of success. The accessory will be destroyed if the reset fails!^000000
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
确定要移除{0}上的所有附魔效果吗？
^FF0000成功率为{1}%。如果重置失败，饰品将会被销毁！^000000

scripts.text: I'll be back later
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text: Please proceed
scripts.translation: 请继续

Please bring me 10 x {0}
scripts.translation:

请给我10个{0}

I need 100,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:

[Amateur Collector]
Darn it...
I have failed and the accessory has been destroyed. I'm so sorry.
scripts.translation:
[业余收藏家]
该死...
我失败了，饰品被销毁了。非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Amateur Collector]
I have succeeded.
The {0} has been initialized.
scripts.translation:

我成功了。
{0}已经初始化。
